_note: ADXL335 analog 3-axis accelerometer module (ADI ADXL335/3xx family). 6-pin: VCC, GND, XOUT, YOUT, ZOUT (ratiometric analog: 0g bias at Vs/2, sensitivity Vs/10 per g — 300 mV/g at 3V), ST (self-test, high adds -1.08g X / +1.08g Y / +1.83g Z). Params: gx/gy/gz in g (default 0/0/1 = flat on bench). ~32k output impedance. Terminal names match engine kind 'adxl335' in bw-board src/devices/accelerometers.js.
